title: Embedded control plane and first-run setup
description: SQLite plane on the hub. POST /api/v1/setup creates the org and owner once.
acceptanceCriteria: Setup returns 409 after the first owner
Session cookie is HttpOnly
Listen stays loopback until an admin changes it

title: Home API for workspaces, nodes, and inbox counts
description: GET /api/v1/home returns workspace status, node health, pending approvals, and node-hours.
acceptanceCriteria: Offline node shows last cache and a timestamp
Mail bodies are not in the payload

title: Node pairing with a one-time code
description: Admin mints a code. The node redeems it from stdin. The plane stores a hash.
acceptanceCriteria: Code expires in 10 minutes and is single use
Token file is mode 0600
Revoke makes the next heartbeat 401

title: Heartbeat and long-poll work items
description: Node dials the plane every 15s and long-polls for decisions and placements.
acceptanceCriteria: Status moves online, degraded, offline on the documented ages
A NAT node needs no inbound port

title: Docker and desktop install shapes
description: Same agent on the Mac app and on Compose.
acceptanceCriteria: Compose pair reads the code from stdin
Desktop can be the embedded plane

title: Create a workspace pinned to one node
description: Admin names a workspace and a primary node.
acceptanceCriteria: A second primary is 409
Personal flag hides invites

title: Move a workspace between nodes
description: Copy, check counts, freeze source, unfreeze target.
acceptanceCriteria: Mismatch discards the import
Routines do not run on both
WhatsApp session is not copied
Ledger repo moves with the data dir
dependencies: Create a workspace pinned to one node

title: Show offline instead of failing over
description: Pinned MVP does not start work on another node.
acceptanceCriteria: Home says Offline
Inbox triage does not run

title: Standby replica and fenced failover
description: Promote a standby when the primary is offline and the replica is fresh.
acceptanceCriteria: Old primary stays frozen if it returns
Sticky WhatsApp stays paused
Lease bounds split brain

title: Main-agent flag on a bot
description: One bot per workspace has role main and is the only ledger writer.
acceptanceCriteria: A second main is rejected
Other bots can propose and cannot commit

title: Drop upstream included model credentials
description: No trial relay, no included Boat key.
acceptanceCriteria: Packaged defaults contain none of the banned hosts
A person's own key still works

title: Retire runOn cloud
description: Routines run only on an unfrozen primary.
acceptanceCriteria: A frozen node does not fire schedules

title: Inbox morning routine
description: System routine at 07:30 that runs triage.
acceptanceCriteria: Overlap skip
Missed when the node is offline
Cursor does not skip mail

title: Connector provider interface
description: Composio, Pipedream, Nango, and MCP behind one interface.
acceptanceCriteria: Plane stores labels not refresh tokens
Upstream broker URL is not the default

title: Bind Gmail as an inbox account
description: A connection can be marked inbox.
acceptanceCriteria: A generic trigger does not become triage
Auth expiry stops triage and says reconnect

title: WhatsApp bridge adapter
description: HTTP adapter to the existing daemon. Allowlist. Sticky.
acceptanceCriteria: Unknown senders are dropped
Outbound send requires approval
Session is not stored on the plane

title: Keep the phone WhatsApp sheet
description: PHONE_SEND_WHATSAPP still works without a bridge.
acceptanceCriteria: Both channels can be on

title: Init the private ledger repo
description: First decision creates a git repo mode 0700 with no remote.
acceptanceCriteria: README and empty decisions.jsonl exist
Shell bots cannot write the repo

title: Append decisions.jsonl
description: Every keep, archive, trash, label, approve, reject, and edit_draft writes action, reason, decided_by, and date.
acceptanceCriteria: Full mail bodies are not stored
A missing reason is confirmed in one sentence
Cancel writes nothing

title: Compile sender and category YAML
description: YAML is a pure function of the log and policy.yaml. One commit per decision.
acceptanceCriteria: Sender beats category
Reject resets trust to ask
git log message has no subject or body

title: ledger.read for every agent
description: Agents must read before a destructive or outgoing action.
acceptanceCriteria: No match means ask
A harness call that acts without a match is rejected

title: Revert a ledger commit
description: Admin revert writes a new reject and recompiles. History is kept.
acceptanceCriteria: The revert itself is a decision

title: Ledger page
description: Show YAML, the log, and commits. File text comes from the node.
acceptanceCriteria: Guests cannot open it
The plane database does not keep the YAML

title: Split inbox Important and Other
description: Triage classifies new Gmail using the ledger.
acceptanceCriteria: Unknown people stay Important
Unknown bulk stays unresolved
Known archive trust archives without a card

title: Cleanup batch approval
description: Unresolved mail groups into one card per sender.
acceptanceCriteria: Approve writes one decision and applies those ids
Reject writes reject and leaves the mail
Unchecking rows archives only the rest

title: Reply drafts that do not send
description: Drafts land in Gmail and in the queue.
acceptanceCriteria: Edit writes edit_draft
Send requires approve
Archive decisions do not grant send

title: Snooze, reminders, and follow-up nudges
description: One-off times live outside the rule files. A nudge is a card.
acceptanceCriteria: Always snooze is the only snooze that becomes a decision
Sending a nudge is a send

title: Trust thresholds and earned-send switch
description: Defaults: archive after 3, trash after 5, label after 2, outgoing off.
acceptanceCriteria: Only the owner can enable earned send
Send trust is per sender and never inferred from edits

title: Outlook inbox provider
description: Same triage through Pipedream or Nango.
acceptanceCriteria: Gmail behavior does not change
Tokens stay at the provider

title: Approval metadata and apply path
description: Plane stores title and prompt hash. Node applies the decision.
acceptanceCriteria: Stale hash is refused
Expiry denies the side effect
Ledger proposal runs after a recorded decision

title: Node-hour meter
description: Managed placement time rolls up. Attached nodes are shown and not billed.
acceptanceCriteria: Self-host has no denominator
Duplicate samples are ignored
Tokens stay a separate estimate

title: Cap managed routines at 100%
description: When the pool is full and overage is off, new routine starts pause.
acceptanceCriteria: Chats still run
Data is not deleted

title: Billing page for self-host
description: Explains there is nothing to pay.
acceptanceCriteria: No card form
No call to Dodo

title: Managed checkout handoff
description: Web checkout via a processor the owner chooses. Webhook sets the hour allowance.
acceptanceCriteria: Desktop only receives a handoff code
Replay of the webhook is ignored
Cancel keeps attached nodes

title: Invites and roles
description: Owner, admin, member. Ledger read and revert follow the table.
acceptanceCriteria: Invite expires in 7 days
Removing a member kills sessions
Members do not see other direct transcripts by default

title: Phone pairing page
description: QR to the node. Phone can approve cleanup and cannot edit policy.
acceptanceCriteria: Code is single use
Earned send is not available on the phone

title: Backup includes the ledger
description: Encrypted backup keeps the git repo and drops secrets and WhatsApp sessions.
acceptanceCriteria: Restore pauses routines
Trust rules come back
Truncating the ledger fails the backup

title: Import an upstream OpenMausBot backup
description: Restore bots without calling upstream and without inventing ledger rules.
acceptanceCriteria: enterprise data is skipped
Old cards are not compiled into rules

title: Point updates at the fork
description: Feed URL is the owner's. autoDownload stays false.
acceptanceCriteria: Windows feed includes latest.yml
Upstream GitHub is not the default

title: Ban upstream hosts in the packaged build
description: A test fails if packaged defaults contain the cloud, account, broker, PostHog, checkout, or relay hosts.
acceptanceCriteria: The test is in CI
CloudProPopup and the cloud-pro notice are unmounted

title: Desktop What's new carousel
description: Three local slides over the bot list: sleep, node-hours, open the hub.
acceptanceCriteria: Not now remembers the release id
Open Agents Hub uses a 60s handoff
No Get Pro and no upstream URL

title: Slack channel adapter
description: Slack app on the node or a connector trigger, same channel row.
acceptanceCriteria: enterprise hosted Slack URL is not used

title: Scheduled backup to a second disk
description: Copy the encrypted archive to a folder or S3-compatible bucket.
acceptanceCriteria: The bucket receives ciphertext

title: OIDC for the plane
description: Self-host can use an identity provider.
acceptanceCriteria: Password login still works

title: Official WhatsApp Business adapter
description: A supported business-number path beside the existing bridge.
acceptanceCriteria: The unofficial bridge is unchanged
No bulk send tools

title: Hermes or other runtime as a node adapter
description: Another agent binary can sit behind the node contract.
acceptanceCriteria: The ledger tool is still the only write path
